description: This file defines the 'FeatureBuilder' interface and associated nested interfaces, which provide a fluent API for constructing 'Feature' objects in various ways, including from JSON, from scratch, or from a copy of existing features. It is part of the 'org.eclipse.ditto.model.things' package and focuses on building features with flexible initialization options.

classes.name: FeatureBuilder
classes.description: A fluent interface for building Feature objects in the Eclipse Ditto model, with nested interfaces for different building strategies.
